title: Grand Theft Auto VI Collection Now at the Rockstar Store - Rockstar Games
summary: Presenting the official Grand Theft Auto VI Collection, featuring new apparel and collectibles inspired by Grand Theft Auto VI, exclusively available now at the Rockstar Store.
text: Grand Theft Auto VI Collection Now at the Rockstar Store - Rockstar Games Skip the Menu Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Get Launcher Open Search Open Player Menu Open Player Menu Newswire Grand Theft Auto VI Announcements Grand Theft Auto VI Collection Now at the Rockstar Store Shop New Apparel and Collectibles October 8, 2026 Presenting the official Grand Theft Auto VI Collection , featuring new apparel and collectibles inspired by Grand Theft Auto VI, exclusively available now at the Rockstar Store. Grand Theft Auto VI and Rockstar Games Logo Tees Choose from an assortment of new heavyweight cotton tees in black, blue, and pink, with designs featuring either the VI logo or the classic Rockstar Games logo. Grand Theft Auto VI Goodtime State and Macca the Gator Tees Get your own piece of Goodtime State Gear, inspired by the styles seen on Jason and Lucia in the Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition , with these tees featuring characters from Leonida’s hit TV show Macca the Gator. Grand Theft Auto VI and Rockstar Games Flexfit Hats The latest collection of stretch-fitted cotton caps at the Rockstar Store feature palm trees nested inside the VI logo along with the original Rockstar baseball cap, now available to pre-order in GTAVI-inspired colors. Collectibles and More… Keep your keys safely together with the Grand Theft Auto VI Keychain . This chrome metal keyring has a laser-etched Rockstar Games logo on one side and the VI logo with palm trees on the other. The chrome two-sided Grand Theft Auto VI – Vice City Money Clip features a blind embossed classic Vice City logo on one side and the VI logo with palm trees on the other. There’s also a refillable, polished chrome Grand Theft Auto VI – Vice City Zippo® Lighter , heavy duty canvas tote bags, and two sets of vinyl stickers. Shop now at store.rockstargames.com and look for much more to be added to the collection. Plus, take advantage of our new wishlisting feature to keep track of desired items and get restock and sale alerts if you are a Rockstar Games mailing list subscriber.
